{{Quote|Plan Zero is the systematic elimination of the Republic's top military leaders. A preemptive strike that will leave the enemy headless.|Darth Baras|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Plan Zero''' was a mysterious operation created in the years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by the [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Baras]]. It was created at the directive of [[Darth Vengean]] though it was Baras who was responsible for taking it forward and had spent a decade in developing it in secret. This was an elegant strategy that aimed at eliminating the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] leadership as part of a strike that would restart open warfare with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

As a result, Baras had not wielded his full strength in the power plays in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Instead, he sought to strike not against the heroes of the Republic but rather at those behind the scenes and led to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] capturing [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agents in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and courting greedy [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] through his proxies.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Plan Zero}}</ref>

Vast resources had been spent in bringing together information on the greatest and most elusive [[General/Legends|generals]] of the Republic. The careful development of this operation meant that no [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was allowed to interfere with Plan Zero and no [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the Republic was allowed to discover it in the fear that they would eventually warn the intended targets.

In the Cold War era, Darth Baras's [[Empire's Wrath|Sith apprentice]] was charged with eliminating each of the great Republic leaders until open war was declared by which point it was expected that victory was assured as a result of the actions of Plan Zero.<ref name="TORC" />
